text: Customers increasingly ask AI where to go. For a local coffee shop, salon, or repair business, that creates a simple question: does the answer include you? Cited gives owners a clear, honest visibility check, then practical fixes they control.

Start with a business name and city. No signup is required. For judges, four saved examples cover different countries and business types. This demonstration uses Brew Lane Cafe, a fictional Portland business. The Sample data badge stays visible. Live checks use real web search and model inference; saved examples let you explore immediately without provider keys.

Every report asks eight customer discovery questions, running each one five times. Brew Lane appears in thirteen of forty saved answers. Five dots show the repeated results for each question. You can inspect every answer. Outlook labels separate broad questions that are unlikely from niche opportunities worth improving. They are heuristics, never promises of ranking or revenue.

The rival explanation carries numbered citations linked to fetched source pages. If a finding cannot cite evidence, Cited rejects it. Here, the fictional rival has clearer services, location, and hours. The sample source explicitly describes the fictional scenario. Real reports store source excerpts and fetch timestamps, so an owner can inspect the evidence behind each explanation.

The fix pack contains a hosted page, a Google Business Profile description with posts and questions, review requests with a QR card, and website schema. Each starts as a draft. Editing stays inside the facts confirmed by the owner. Adding unconfirmed twenty-four-hour opening times blocks approval. Restoring supported facts allows approval. Only that explicit tap unlocks copying and publishes the page.

The approved page is fast and server rendered. Real business pages include Local Business and FAQ structured data. Fictional example pages stay labeled, remain noindex, and omit business structured data. Manual rechecks show changes across forty runs. Weekly rechecks repeat the same questions, with an opt-in schedule and durable progress.

All runtime AI calls go through Nebius Token Factory. NVIDIA Nemotron Nano performs the repeated recommendations, Super resolves businesses and verifies cited explanations, and Ultra drafts and checks fixes. Tavily Search and Extract retrieve the evidence. Supabase is the production persistence and optional login integration. Cited is open source under MIT. Scores come from Nemotron plus web search, not live ChatGPT results. Small businesses get clarity, evidence, and an approved next step.
